content: नियुक्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Directed, ordered, instructed, commanded. .²2 Authorised, appointed; नियुक्तः क्षत्रियो द्रव्ये खड्गं दर्शयते ध्रुवम् <ls>H. 2. 95</ls>. .²3 Permitted to raise issue; see नियोग (7) below. .²4 Attached to. .²5 Fastened to. .²6 Ascertained. .²7 Prompted, incited. .²8 Used, employed; नियुक्तौ हव्यकव्ययोः <ls>Ms. 5. 16</ls>. .{@-क्तः@} A functionary, an officer, any one charged with some business. .{@-क्तम्@} {%ind.%} By all means, necessarily.
